methods.name: onPlayerTick(PlayerTickEvent.Post)
methods.purpose: 服务端每 tick：① 按 getEffectiveMaxSpirit clamp 精神力；② 按 Config.spiritRegenInterval 恢复（base + getSkillRegenFlatBonus，×(1 + getSkillRegenPercentBonus)）；③ 每 20 tick 按 getSpiritFlowRegenPerSecond 回复上限百分比（精神洪流）；④ 调度 handleNightVision / handleSpiritSatiety / handleSpiritMaintenance；⑤ 按 Config.syncInterval 节流 syncTo；⑥ 每 1200 tick 落盘 SpiritPersistence.save（需 isPersistenceReady）。【注意：当前未调用 handleSpiritFlight，需补一行】

methods.name: handleNightVision(ServerPlayer, PlayerSpirit)
methods.purpose: 被动激活时每 NIGHT_VISION_CHECK_INTERVAL（100 tick）检查，剩余 < NIGHT_VISION_REFRESH_TICKS（200）时续 220 tick 夜视；无精神力消耗；关闭时不清效果自然过期。

methods.name: handleSpiritSatiety(ServerPlayer, PlayerSpirit)
methods.purpose: 被动激活时每 tick 保证 foodLevel=20 / saturation=5.0 / exhaustion=0，只在不足时写入，触发原版自然回血。

methods.name: handleSpiritMaintenance(ServerPlayer, PlayerSpirit)
methods.purpose: 被动激活时每 MAINTENANCE_INTERVAL（20 tick）遍历 Inventory.getContainerSize()（背包 36 + 盔甲 4 + 副手 1），收集所有损坏物品，随机选一件恢复 3×lv 耐久，markDirty。

methods.name: handleSpiritFlight(ServerPlayer, PlayerSpirit)
methods.purpose: 状态机：① 被动关闭 → setFlightState(false,false) + 清 Slow Falling + 清 accum/gliding；② 创造/旁观不干预；③ 缓降中且 spirit ≥ baseCost × 5 → 退出缓降恢复 mayFly，否则继续 Slow Falling；④ 正常飞行按 rising（deltaMovement.y > 0.05）判断消耗 ×2 或 ×1，累积器扣精神力，耗尽进入缓降并提示；⑤ 确保 mayFly = true；⑥ 按 syncInterval 节流同步。【当前未被 onPlayerTick 调用】

methods.name: onPlayerTick(PlayerTickEvent.Post)
methods.purpose: 服务端每 tick：被动 EMC_CONVERSION_ID 激活时调用 processEmcConversion。职责仅限技能 tick 逻辑，与精神力恢复/落盘分离。

methods.name: processEmcConversion(ServerPlayer, PlayerSpirit)
methods.purpose: ① 等级 ≤ 0 直接关闭被动；② 按 Config.emcConversionBaseInterval 固定间隔触发；③ perFragment = SkillValues.emcPerFragment(skillLevel, visionLevel)；④ targetCost = max(perFragment, ceil(Config.emcConversionEmcCost × emcCostMultiplier)) × skillLevel；⑤ gain = max(1, targetCost / perFragment)；⑥ emcCost = gain × perFragment（对齐整数倍）；⑦ EMC 不足则关闭被动 + syncTo + 聊天栏提示 no_emc；⑧ 扣 EMC + addVisionFragments(gain) + markDirty；⑨ 按 syncInterval 节流同步。
